config.source:
SELECT
  Index,
  Country,
  Year,
  MAKE_DATE(Year, 12, 31) AS Year_End_Date,
  Ending_Close AS Year_End_Close,
  Starting_Close AS Previous_Year_End_Close,
  Annual_Return_Percentage,
  Ending_Close / FIRST_VALUE(Ending_Close) OVER (PARTITION BY Index ORDER BY Year) * 100 AS Rebased_Close,
  CASE
    WHEN Country = 'United States' THEN 'North America'
    WHEN Country IN ('Japan', 'China', 'India', 'Indonesia') THEN 'Asia'
    WHEN Country IN ('United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Turkey') THEN 'Europe'
    WHEN Country = 'Brazil' THEN 'Latin America'
    WHEN Country = 'Saudi Arabia' THEN 'Middle East'
  END AS Region
FROM global_stock_market.gold.annual_returns

config.source:
SELECT
  Index,
  Country,
  Number_Of_Trading_Days,
  Start_Date,
  End_Date,
  Average_Daily_Return,
  Daily_volatility,
  Daily_Volatility_Category,
  CASE
    WHEN Country = 'United States' THEN 'North America'
    WHEN Country IN ('Japan', 'China', 'India', 'Indonesia') THEN 'Asia'
    WHEN Country IN ('United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Turkey') THEN 'Europe'
    WHEN Country = 'Brazil' THEN 'Latin America'
    WHEN Country = 'Saudi Arabia' THEN 'Middle East'
  END AS Region
FROM global_stock_market.gold.daily_volatility_stats

SELECT
  Index,
  Country,
  Year,
  Month_Number,
  Month_End_Date,
  First_Close,
  Month_End_Close,
  Previous_Month_End_Close,
  Monthly_Return_Percentage,
  CASE
    WHEN Country = 'United States' THEN 'North America'
    WHEN Country IN ('Japan', 'China', 'India', 'Indonesia') THEN 'Asia'
    WHEN Country IN ('United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Turkey') THEN 'Europe'
    WHEN Country = 'Brazil' THEN 'Latin America'
    WHEN Country = 'Saudi Arabia' THEN 'Middle East'
  END AS Region
FROM global_stock_market.gold.monthly_index_trends

WITH vol AS (
  SELECT
    v.Index,
    v.Country,
    v.Daily_volatility * SQRT(252) AS Annualized_Volatility,
    CASE
      WHEN v.Country = 'United States' THEN 'North America'
      WHEN v.Country IN ('Japan', 'China', 'India', 'Indonesia') THEN 'Asia'
      WHEN v.Country IN ('United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Turkey') THEN 'Europe'
      WHEN v.Country = 'Brazil' THEN 'Latin America'
      WHEN v.Country = 'Saudi Arabia' THEN 'Middle East'
    END AS Region
  FROM global_stock_market.gold.daily_volatility_stats v
),
avg_ret AS (
  SELECT
    Index,
    AVG(Annual_Return_Percentage) AS Avg_Annual_Return
  FROM global_stock_market.gold.annual_returns
  GROUP BY Index
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    v.Index,
    v.Country,
    v.Region,
    v.Annualized_Volatility,
    COALESCE(a.Avg_Annual_Return, 0) AS Avg_Annual_Return
  FROM vol v
  LEFT JOIN avg_ret a ON v.Index = a.Index
)
SELECT
  Index,
  Country,
  Region,
  'Annualized Volatility' AS Metric,
  Annualized_Volatility AS Metric_Value
FROM combined
UNION ALL
SELECT
  Index,
  Country,
  Region,
  'Avg Annual Return' AS Metric,
  Avg_Annual_Return AS Metric_Value
FROM combined

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    Index,
    Country,
    Year,
    Year_End_Close,
    CASE
      WHEN Country = 'United States' THEN 'North America'
      WHEN Country IN ('Japan', 'China', 'India', 'Indonesia') THEN 'Asia'
      WHEN Country IN ('United Kingdom', 'Germany', 'Turkey') THEN 'Europe'
      WHEN Country = 'Brazil' THEN 'Latin America'
      WHEN Country = 'Saudi Arabia' THEN 'Middle East'
    END AS Region
  FROM global_stock_market.gold.yearly_index_trends
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    Index,
    Country,
    Region,
    MIN(Year) AS First_Year,
    MAX(Year) AS Last_Year,
    COUNT(*) AS Num_Years
  FROM yearly
  GROUP BY Index, Country, Region
),
full_cagr AS (
  SELECT
    b.Index,
    b.Country,
    b.Region,
    b.First_Year,
    b.Last_Year,
    b.Num_Years,
    yf.Year_End_Close AS First_Close,
    yl.Year_End_Close AS Last_Close,
    (POWER(yl.Year_End_Close / yf.Year_End_Close, 1.0 / (b.Num_Years - 1)) - 1) * 100 AS Full_Period_CAGR,
    (yl.Year_End_Close / yf.Year_End_Close - 1) * 100 AS Cumulative_Price_Return
  FROM bounds b
  JOIN yearly yf ON yf.Index = b.Index AND yf.Year = b.First_Year
  JOIN yearly yl ON yl.Index = b.Index AND yl.Year = b.Last_Year
),
ten_year AS (
  SELECT
    b.Index,
    (POWER(yl.Year_End_Close / ys.Year_End_Close, 1.0 / 10) - 1) * 100 AS Ten_Year_CAGR
  FROM bounds b
  JOIN yearly yl ON yl.Index = b.Index AND yl.Year = b.Last_Year
  JOIN yearly ys ON ys.Index = b.Index AND ys.Year = b.Last_Year - 10
)
SELECT
  f.Index,
  f.Country,
  f.Region,
  f.First_Year,
  f.Last_Year,
  f.Num_Years,
  f.First_Close,
  f.Last_Close,
  f.Full_Period_CAGR,
  f.Cumulative_Price_Return,
  t.Ten_Year_CAGR
FROM full_cagr f
LEFT JOIN ten_year t ON t.Index = f.Index
